svg.title: V7 · Bounded handler access
svg.desc: Isolated handler: No raw SQL connection, database credentials, ambient network or broad host mount. Only declared transaction capabilities. Controlled gateway: Freeze canonical identities. Check every attempted read/write before storage access. Returning state to its old value cannot hide an attempt. Consumer-owned transaction: Authorization, native invariant checks, replay ledger and outbox are control responsibilities. Their reads are not handler permissions. Commit or rollback: Verify outputs, constraints, frame and postconditions. Failure aborts the whole attempted transaction; no partial business outcome.

g.text: Only transaction capability messages. No raw SQL, database secrets
Freeze aliases. Refuse outside-frame attempts before access.
Invariants + current policy + replay + outbox. Control reads are
Verify before commit; failures roll back the attempted transaction.
